# EDIT PLAN (auto-generated from tools/timeline.py)

Style follows the channel: mostly full-screen episode footage, hard cuts, and restrained documentary graphics (cream case-file cards, marker math on notebook paper, typed record cards with red circles, pinned screenshots, yellow-on-navy keyword cards, black quote cards). No shakes/flashes/glitches. **No music.**

Each shot starts on the **bold anchor words** and runs until the next shot. `C##` = episode clip, `B##` = dialogue bite (narration pauses, the show line plays with its own audio), `GFX` = original graphic.
